summary: Production Web and native Flutter DM/search/composer workflows against disposable actual Go/PostgreSQL secure-cookie API, with real third-administrator DM denial. Observed emulator/simulator and controlled browser results are separated from physical-device gates.

confirmed_defect_and_fix.observed_before: Closing and reopening global search lost the origin query, while singleton filters leaked into a different DM.
confirmed_defect_and_fix.focused_RED_before_implementation: Actual SearchPanel browser regression failed on leaked author filter. Subsequent reviewer cases failed for re-submitting an unsubmitted edited query and restoring scroll on the non-scrollable result list.
confirmed_defect_and_fix.implemented_behavior: Pinia in-memory origin-scoped query/filter/search session retains input and last submitted query separately, refetches actual results, and restores the actual search-aside scroll owner. Existing authenticated-state teardown disposes the store between accounts.

observations.clipboard_method: Actual platform Clipboard.setData/getData via EditableTextState.pasteText; controlled Flutter action, not physical paste gesture
observations.lifecycle_dispatch: adb KEYCODE_HOME then explicit launch of owned QA package; actual Android lifecycle observer

actual_SearchPanel_browser_fixture.scope: Origin/account retention, fresh denied re-fetch, unsubmitted query, real scroll owner; component proof only.

existing_calendar_browser_fixture.scope: UTC/New York date range, pagination and mobile/desktop submit.

native_DM_draft_widget.scope: Two-conversation draft switching through actual TextField; component proof only.

runner_contracts.scope: Exact device ownership, previous-attempt archive, missing-row rejection, unauthorized lifecycle control causes no OS dispatch.

focused_source.scope: Focused tests establish behavior and regression only; actual device/backend evidence is separate.

attempt_transparency: Original Web API runs used an older immutable dist without a full source-pair receipt; they are not used as source-matched After evidence.
Docker readiness from a non-mounted private path and early locator failures were harness setup failures; corrected attempts start with RUNNING and archive previous captures.

Native enterText after screenshot unfocus dropped text before conversation switching. Actual tap/pump before input plus an immediate controller assertion corrected the harness; no Flutter product defect was inferred.
The product search-retention failure and follow-up query/scroll review regressions were preserved as focused RED before corrections.

The first final Web Docker build failed before UI with destination image SHA not found. It remains an archived environment build failure; a specific underlying cache/concurrency cause was not proved. Retry runs completed both widths.
Additional 1440px actual replays investigated a suspected blank history. Original capture and unchanged ROI pixels refuted the interpretation; no product renderer change was made.

privacy.accounts_and_message_content: Only fixed synthetic disposable fixtures appear in local ignored PNGs. Public evidence contains no live session/control secrets, private message payloads or DM/account IDs.
privacy.capture_publication: PNG stays ignored .out; hashes and paths only.

runtime_scope.source_handling: Each platform preserves its measured source, QA harness and artifact hashes. Later root global source changes are separate evidence; no old runtime is relabelled as the final publication candidate.
runtime_scope.Android_source: Measured Flutter lib manifest equals full tracked lib at candidate d78e5ea6.
runtime_scope.iOS_source: Measured later Flutter lib includes the separately implemented admin-section retention changes. This DM workflow does not exercise admin-section retention.
runtime_scope.native_filter_scope: Native runtime verifies query and all/current scope. Web additionally verifies author/attachment filter isolation and actual 24-result scroll restoration.
runtime_scope.native_backend_provenance: Native runs predate the backend snapshot-manifest addition; they prove actual disposable Go/PostgreSQL API behavior but do not contain a backend source-manifest hash. Final Web runs contain guarded backend snapshot and Docker image identity.
runtime_scope.OS_geometry: Native actual observed IME inset and safe-area padding were zero. Controlled viewport resizing proves Flutter layout only.

visual_review.web: 393px drill-in and 1440px split view retain recipient, message/result context, composer and restored filters/scroll. Empty Web DM shows status and usable composer. Multiline composer is internally scrollable with Send visible.
visual_review.native: Actual Flutter empty-state CTA, recipient, search/context back, distinct retained drafts and multiline composer are visible without RenderFlex overflow in measured captures.
visual_review.capture_limit: Flutter raster screenshots exclude certification of native OS keyboard, physical safe area and physical gesture behavior.

paint_diagnosis.reason: An initial image inspection interpreted desktop history as blank. Bounded replays and original-resolution reinspection show synthetic rows16–24 with reactions and the multiline composer. Parent independently reviewed the original capture and confirmed visible history.

read_only_ROI_pixel_analysis.method: Read-only RGB ROI x320,y70,x1100,y750; no edited or masked evidence image exported.

paint_diagnosis.hit_test_limit: A probe hit the header using a partially clipped first row; it is not used as occlusion proof.

provenance_clarification.scope: Archived root upstream proof is byte-identical to the receipt referenced at the guarded copy. Own immutable build receipt, source-map, dist and measured runtime hashes are unchanged; later source freezes are separate evidence.
